'''Fujian''' is the son of [[Fuyan]], the owner of [[Huaipu Mining Firm]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Night)
:'''Fujian:''' Hey Dad, got all the goods in. Care to take a look?
:'''Fuyan:''' Hmm... This batch looks good.
:'''Fujian:''' You know it, Dad. Jinzhou boasts top-notch minerals. Quality is never an issue here!
:'''Fuyan:''' And the prices?
:'''Fujian:''' Already sorted it with the Mineral Corporation. Stick to the old rules. No need to factor in the recent price changes.
:'''Fuyan:''' We didn't take advantage of them, right?
:'''Fujian:''' Dad, trust me. We didn't take any advantage. We've been loyal customers, and with my staff discount, this is the right price.
:'''Fuyan:''' Good, good. Remember, son, fair play keeps the business rolling.
{{Dialogue End}}
